_doc: Markers for what the player built (player report 5), on the full map and the tether's minimap. Each layer marks the placed structures that provide any of its `provides` tags (an entry ending in ':' matches by prefix, e.g. 'storage:'); a structure joins the first layer that matches. The legend on the full map toggles a layer (Settings.map_layers, saved); `default` is its state before the player touches it. Add a layer here, no code change: label (legend text), color (hex), shape (house | square | diamond | circle), default (bool). Left unmarked on purpose: logs, walls, stairs, doors, traps, lights and campfires (too many, or nothing to come back for).
